Len Marchant and John Cope were our mainstays in the middle distance events and as usual we always had plenty of men to call on for the long distance races.
John Cope was second to Pugh in the 440 and we had first two home in the 880 in Len Marchant and Jack Brown. Bill Lucas won the mile and Eddie Short won the two miles, beating Ted Stimpson.
We lost the Medley Relay where John Cope tried hard to hold Nankeville over the first 880 but the Walton man gave his team the lead which they maintained to the end.
Alan Sexton also won the discus event and is proving to be quite an all-round athlete. Results were as follows— 220 yards: 1, Barker;; 2, J.

John Cope won the 880 yards with Archie Bedford third and Len Marchant won the mile with Len Adams third. We won the senior 4 x 100 yards relay and in the field events, Charlie Jones won the long jump and John MacKenzie the discus throw.
In the 880 yards John Cope was fifth in his heat. In the mile, Derrick Burfitt won his heat in 4.20, but in the final was seventh in 4 min. 19 secs.

Jim Heathfield was third in the 440, John Cope won the 880 in 2 mins. 1.6 secs., while Bill Lucas won the mile in 4 mins. 30.2 secs. Charlie Smart, home on leave from Germany, turned out in the 2 miles and clocked 9 mins. 45 secs. to win a good race with Ted Stimpson second.

John Cope won the 440 in 51.3 secs. Derek Burfitt had a hard tussle with Martin of Surrey in the mile to win in 4 mins. 27 secs. with Jack Brown third.
